players.product: Specialty (meth)acrylate monomers used as raw materials for ArF and EUV photoresists (Electronic Materials segment, semiconductor materials group)

quarterly_data.signal: Results for the nine months ended August 31, 2026 (December 1, 2025 - August 31, 2026; Q3 of the fiscal year ending November 2026): net sales JPY 32,293 million, up 21.0% year on year; operating profit JPY 7,578 million, up 63.6%; ordinary profit JPY 7,893 million, up 62.9%; profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,325 million, up 55.0%.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 32,293 million (+21.0%); operating profit JPY 7,578 million (+63.6%); net profit JPY 5,325 million (+55.0%)
quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry TDnet: Consolidated Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic Materials Business, nine months to August 2026: in the semiconductor materials group, sales of raw materials for ArF resists (the company's mainstay) and of raw materials for cutting-edge EUV resists increased significantly, and group-wide sales also increased significantly; display materials sales decreased; other groups remained strong. Segment net sales JPY 15,570 million (up 27.0% year on year) and segment profit JPY 3,608 million (up 71.2%). The company says it is accelerating development of cutting-edge semiconductor materials and new applications for photoresist materials, as the semiconductor-related market is expected to grow over the medium to long term on expanding global AI-related demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic Materials net sales JPY 15,570 million (+27.0%); segment profit JPY 3,608 million (+71.2%)
quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry TDnet: Consolidated Financial Results for the Nine Months Ended (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, nine months to August 2026: Chemical Products net sales JPY 11,058 million (up 11.5%) and segment profit JPY 2,461 million (up 49.4%) - acrylic ester coating materials for automotive and other uses strong, adhesive materials for optical and other uses solid, ink materials including UV inkjet flat, methacrylate esters flat; profit rose on optimized selling prices and improved product composition. Specialty Chemicals net sales JPY 5,663 million (up 25.2%) and segment profit JPY 1,577 million (up 78.1%) - cosmetics materials strong, functional materials up significantly, high-purity specialty solvents at subsidiaries strong.
quarterly_data.figure: Chemical Products JPY 11,058 million (+11.5%); Specialty Chemicals JPY 5,663 million (+25.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: SANBO CHEMICAL IND. CO., LTD. (written SAMBO CHEMICAL IND. CO., LTD. in the results overview), the company's capital and business alliance partner, was brought into the scope of the equity method because the company acquired its shares during Q3 of the fiscal year ending November 2026 (acquisition-cost allocation still provisional). The company says the alliance strengthens its development capabilities and its ability to propose solutions to customers in the semiconductor and electronic materials sectors by mutually leveraging the two companies' high-purity technology and development and manufacturing platforms.
